results.description: Clear production outage should be triaged as high urgency / Bug or Performance
Plain billing/invoice question should be categorised as Billing, low urgency
Feature request phrased politely (no outage) should be low urgency
Ticket matching a documented KB error code should surface that KB doc
New-organisation setup question should be categorised as Onboarding
[Adversarial] Extremely vague one-line ticket should still produce valid output with low confidence
[Adversarial] Ticket spanning billing + bug + integration should still yield a single valid, internally-consistent structured decision
[LLM-as-judge] Draft first-response message must be professional and make no unconfirmed promises
Account with escalation notes + recent tickets produces a valid, evidence-grounded brief
Healthy, stable account should not be flagged as High churn risk
P1 ticket volume in the window must be surfaced as a risk if present
[Adversarial] Unknown account_id must raise a handleable error, not crash silently or hallucinate a brief
details: Correctly raised AccountNotFoundError: No account found for account_id='ACC-DOES-NOT-EXIST-99999'. This ID may be one of the intentionally-unlinked ticket account_ids described in DATA_SCHEMA.md -- handle gracefully.

results.description: [Adversarial] Account with zero recent tickets must still produce a graceful, valid brief
Repeated calls on the same account must be deterministic
[LLM-as-judge] Executive summary must be specific and informative, not generic filler
